articles.title: gamescom awesome indies show: How to Watch
articles.summary: August is here, and that means gamescom is almost upon us. Once again, the biggest games event in the world is host to thrilling showcases, hands-on demos, a cosplay contest and more!
body: Produced in partnership with IGN, gamescom’s official production partner, this year’s edition of the gamescom awesome indies show will feature in-depth game previews of select indie titles, bringing you closer to the most exciting games featured in the show.
If you're a content creator or streamer that wants to co-stream the show, follow this link to apply to become an official co-streamer and get access to exclusive OBS assets.

Hosted by Jane Douglas and Daemon Hatfield, the gamescom awesome indies show will give viewers an early look at some of the most innovative, inspiring and eye-catching games coming from independent developers and publishers.
Last year’s gamescom awesome indies show featured fast-paced train car platformer Denshattack!, sprawling Disco-like RPG Esoteric Ebb, and Rebounder, a precision platformer set in a pulp-print world.
articles.author: George Forsyth-Nash

articles.title: The Most Important Sci-Fi Movie of the Century Is Officially Streaming on Hulu
articles.summary: It’s tough to picture it now, but AI used to be the stuff of science fiction. Ever since the ‘60s, the topic has been fertile ground for inspiration, resulting in memorable creations, from the evil HAL in 2001: A Space Odyssey to the pity-inducing replicants of Blade Runner.
body: However, one movie released over a decade ago managed to predict where technology and culture were headed better than almost any other, making it the perfect bridge between the past and future of AI-based sci-fi. That movie is streaming now on Hulu.

Twelve years ago, Alex Garland released one of his best and most thought-provoking movies. Ex Machina marked his directorial debut after writing the scripts for films like 28 Days Later and Sunshine, and it remains one of the sharpest works of his career. It’s a project that asks some uncomfortable questions about humanity and presents one of the most truthful depictions of men. Even stripped of its sci-fi gloss, Ex Machina stands the test of time because, beyond exploring cool topics like humanoids and tech, it’s ultimately a movie about men and the way in which they view women.
articles.author: Maria Loreto

articles.title: 20-year-old Gunz the Duel gets Steam re-release, receives harsh criticism over network issues and suspected use of generative AI
articles.summary: Gunz the Duel, the cult classic 3rd-person action game first released back in 2006, is back on Steam. But the long-awaited return of the genre-defining game has been tarred somewhat by technical issues, and allegations of AI usage.
body: Gunz the Duel was first developed by MAIET Entertainment, but has been brought to modern platforms by Masangsoft. This resurrection of Gunz the Duel has been in the works for a few years, and has built up organic hype from older PC players with fond memories of Gunz.

However, with the game releasing on Steam over the weekend, expectations were met with reality, and a wave of criticisms hit Gunz the Duel. For one, the game is reportedly suffering from significant technical issues.

"Masangsoft is a group of talented individuals. Not only did they manage to ruin a 20 year old game, but they consistently discover new ways to make it worse," wrote user Fizzion. They go on to say that in-game events and gifts aren't working properly, and that the beloved gameplay experience itself is different than it was in the original title. They explain: "When slashing a blocking enemy - even with angles taken into consideration - flinching/stagger almost never happens and seems very inconsistent."
articles.author: Connor Makar

articles.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, a remake of the first game, is getting RPG skill trees, crafting mechanics and a 'focus meter'
articles.summary: Amazon Game Studios and Crystal Dynamics have released a new trailer for Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis. It's the sixth instalment in a series of 'behind-the-scenes' videos chronicling the making of the upcoming remake, which is being developed by Flying Wild Hog.
body: Legacy of Atlantis' "fiery, fabulous and fit" incarnation of Lara has been designed to feel agile and dangerous. She also comes with a 'focus' meter that fills as you deal damage, take damage, and dodge attacks. 'Focus' allows you to slow down time around you and engage in acrobatic maneuvers that feel good "on the sticks". This is different from the original title where Lara could perform acrobatic movements on the fly, without the need for a specific 'focus' bar.

"When I played the Survivor series [Tomb Raider 2013 onwards] and I could suddenly affect and increase Lara's power in the game," says design director Jason Epps, "I felt much more engaged." As a result, he notes, there is now an RPG-like skill tree in the game, as well as a mechanic that sees you collecting herbs that can be brewed to give you buffs that reduce damage or restore health. Unlike the Survivor series, you don't gain experience points for upgrades by performing different tasks, but rather by collecting artefacts found dotted around the levels.
articles.author: Dom Peppiatt

articles.title: The Practical ASUS ZenScreen 16" 1080p Portable USB Monitor Is on Sale From Newegg via AliExpress
articles.summary: It's no surprise why USB portable monitors are becoming so popular. They provide extra screen real estate for laptop users and they're much slimmer and lighter than your average monitor so you can carry them around.
body: Newegg, via its official AliExpress storefront, is offering the ASUS ZenScreen 15.6" USB Portable Monitor (MB169CK) for just $101.35 with free shipping after $16 off coupon code " IFPT04BD ". That beat's Amazon's price by about $8. There are many portable monitor brands out there, but ASUS is generally considered amongst the highest quality options.

The ASUS ZenScreen is a 15.6" monitor that's designed to be portable. It weighs just 1.7 pounds and measures less than 0.5 thin. It sports a sturdy metal frame and includes a 360-degree adjustable kickstand for both portrait and landscape orientations. The 15.6" IPS display features a 1080p resolution (141ppi), 60Hz refresh rate, wide 178-degree viewing angle, and an anti-glare matte surface.

Connectivity options include two USB Type-C ports and one mini HDMI port to connect to a laptop, tablet, or handheld gaming PC for use as a main or secondary display. If your device is equipped with a USB Type-C output with Power Delivery, then a single cable can be used for both video and power. Otherwise, you'll need two cables: a mini HDMI or USB Type-C cable for video and a second USB Type-C cable to a wall charger for power.
articles.author: Eric Song

articles.title: "I'm pretty sure I mean it" - Legendary game developer Warren Spector announces retirement
articles.summary: Warren Spector, the legendary game developer known for being a key part in the development of the Deus Ex series as well as his role in Epic Mickey, Ultima, and System Shock, has announced his retirement.
body: "With all that behind me and with age and health (my business) catching up with me I'm feeling like I've done what I set out to do. It's time to write some books, do a lot of reading, do some lecturing, maybe do some consulting. (Feel free to get in touch about those last two.) Also there's a keyboard here just waiting for me to get my piano chops back.

"I definitely have mixed feelings about this. I mean there are three games in particular I'd still like to make. (One is very big... one is very small... and one I don't know how to make which scares me.) But the game business has changed and it's just not as much fun for me anymore. Plus there's a new generation of developers coming up who deserve their time in the sun.

"To all of you reading this I want you to remember that games are not a solved problem yet -- there is, I hope, plenty of experimentation and innovation to come. And to all you young developers out there, I've said it before and I'll say it again, your job is to make people forget people like me ever existed.
"Will I come back? Never say never. But I think it's time to ride off into the sunset. Now stop reading and make great games."
articles.author: Connor Makar

articles.title: Shuhei Yoshida told Expedition 33 studio to avoid terms like 'turn-based RPG' because it may cause people to "overlook" the game
articles.summary: One of the reasons Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 stood out so much in early footage was how action-packed its combat looked, despite being a turn-based RPG. But while developer Sandfall Interactive has described the game as a turn-based RPG - and reinvigorated the genre, to some degree - not everyone…
body: Veteran PlayStation executive Shuhei Yoshida revealed at the Busan Indie Connect Festival 2026 over the weekend that he warned Expedition 33 developers not to give the game that label (via Automaton ).

Yoshida was impressed by the game's combat, likening it to The Legend of Dragoon's, a game he was the producer of. However, his advice was for the team to pick a different term to describe the game, since he believed 'turn-based RPG' is an outdated term to some players, who could end up dismissing the game as a result.
"It's incredibly well-made, but it would be better not to call it a turn-based RPG. That alone might cause players to overlook it," Yoshida said, as reported by 4Gamer.

Yoshida, who worked as an advisor to publishers and developers around the time of his departure from PlayStation in 2025, revealed the anecdote in a panel aimed at helping indie developers pick the right publisher for their games and making a convincing pitch. As part of his consulting work, he worked with Expedition 33 publisher Kepler Interactive, where he got to play a demo of the game two years before its launch.
articles.author: Sherif Saed

articles.title: James Gunn Defends the Tonal Shift of the DCU After Lanterns Stirs Conversation With Gritty First Episode
articles.summary: DC Studios co-CEO and Superman director James Gunn has stepped in to defend Lanterns and clarified why the DCU won't be "of one tone" going forward. Warning! Light spoilers for Lanterns Season 1 Episode 1 follow.
body: Fans were surprised to hear Hal Jordan (Kyle Chandler) and John Stewart (Aaron Pierre) dropping F-bombs when DC and HBO premiered their new Green Lantern show last night. The True Detective-inspired buddy-cop drama is much darker and grittier than the projects it follows, and naturally, that's resulted in some pushback online.

We should note that, generally speaking, audiences and critics seem to have walked away from the first Lanterns episode with glowing reviews (IGN gave it an 8/10 ). However, while Marvel built its movie empire on a cinematic universe that largely blends between movies, there is a conversation brewing about how the DCU will be able to balance generally family-friendly films like Superman and Supergirl with some of the more cutthroat moments we've seen in Lanterns.

"As an 'Elseworlds' story, this first episode of Lanterns is way better than the conceit of 'True Detective meets DCU,'" one fan said on Threads. "That said — and along with Supergirl, Creature Commandos, and the upcoming Clayface movie — I can’t comprehend this slate toward building a shared narrative universe."
articles.author: Michael Cripe

articles.title: Amazon's Game of Thrones T-Shirt Sale Has Some Great House of the Dragon Designs
articles.summary: The Game of Thrones franchise may have lost some steam with its controversial final season, but the spin-off shows have more than made up for that since. Season 3 of House of the Dragon especially brought the heat this year and delivered some excellent television for eight straight episodes.
body: With more Game of Thrones spin-offs still on the horizon, there are plenty of reasons to be a proud fan of George R.R. Martin's brutal fantasy world. And Amazon's latest T-shirt sale is all the reason you need to showcase a love for your favorite dragon show with a layer of fabric on your body.

Similar to Amazon's recent Lord of the Rings shirt sale, the discount here isn't that massive. These shirts are normally $19.99, so you're only really saving $2. Still, $2 isn't nothing and some of these designs are actually really cool. The full sale includes a lot of classic Game of Thrones quotes and characters, but it's primarily the House of the Dragon options that have caught my eye.

My overall favorite shirt in this sale is the dragon collage. Some of my favorite episodes in The Game of Thrones were the ones where Daenerys showcased the full might of her fiery babies and straight up cooked some folks. So the fact that House of the Dragon has way more dragons is what really made me fall in love with that show. Each dragon on this shirt is illustrated in full color and looks like its pulled straight from a Targaryen guide book.
articles.author: Jacob Kienlen

articles.title: Death Stranding meets party-based tactical combat in mesmerising open world RPG Fog'n'Silence, in which you lead twisted humans through the Afterlife
articles.summary: On viewing the trailer for Fog'n'Silence, I transformed instantly into a caricature of a Texan oilman. "Hoowee!!" I whooped, hurling down my my ten gallon hat and firing my ivory-handled six shooter into the air.
body: Created by Kyiv-based Hello Andromeda, this is a grim and enveloping party-based open world RPG that, according to studio co-founder Vlad Muntian, takes inspiration from Kenshi, Death Stranding, and Outer Wilds. It puts you in charge of a group of Vagrants exploring the vast plains of the Afterlife. You'll deal with transmogrifying fog, sneak around blind monsters, tackle esoteric physics, and (if you must) take part in freeze-time combat that sees Vagrants and adversaries plotting actions, then playing them out simultaneously. All the while dealing with lasting injuries, mounting hunger, and rapidly decreasing sanity.

You control everything by means of a flying drone, which makes for some panoramic presentation, with pathetically tiny humanoids in Hazmats scurrying over miles of sickly sand, rock and… skin? Yeah, pretty sure that's skin. Also pretty sure one of your party members has two heads. Look at your minions go, picking a path among lurid fractal meshes, concrete ribcages, and fields of metallic follicles. Hoowee! (hat, sixshooter, etc) I have got to get me some of those fields of metallic follicles!!
articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell

articles.title: The 65" Samsung S90F 4K QD-OLED TV Drops to $1,198 with Free Shipping on Amazon
articles.summary: Amazon just dropped the price of one of Samsung's best gaming TVs. A brand new 65" Samsung S90F 4K QD-OLED Smart TV deal is currently on sale for $1,197.91 with free shipping. It's sold and shipped through Amazon directly. The S90F is one of Samsung's higher-tier OLED TVs.
body: The S90F is the 2025 model in Samsung's S90 OLED TV lineup. It sits just below the S95 (Samsung's highest end model) and the S84/S8F. Versus the competition, it's most directly compared to LG's Evo C5. The S90F is equipped with Samsung's coveted quantum dot OLED panel. QD OLED TVs are brighter than traditional WOLED TVs while retaining all of the other benefits of OLED like the near instaneous response time, true black levels, and near-infinite contrast ratio.

The Samsung S90F also has the features you'd want in a gaming TV, including a native 120Hz panel and HDMI 2.1 ports so you can run PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X games in 4K resolution at up to 120fps.

Despite being a current generation console, the Nintendo Switch 2 has lax TV requirements compared to the PS5 or Xbox Series X. When the Switch is connected to its dock and a television, it can only output a 4K resolution signal at up to 60 frames per second. That said, the Switch 2 will still benefit greatly from the OLED's stellar image quality.
articles.author: Eric Song

articles.title: Razer Naga V3 Pro review
articles.summary: James is a more recent PC gaming convert, often admiring graphics cards, cases, and motherboards from afar. It was not until 2019, after just finishing a degree in law and media, that they decided to throw out the last few years of education, build their PC, and start writing about gaming…
body: Razer's Naga series has always been a bit eye-catching. Slapping tens of buttons on a gaming mouse will naturally make it stand out in the looks department, but having owned two Nagas in my lifetime, I can see it only really takes an evening to get why people love 'em.

MMOs are notorious for demanding lots of shortcuts and macros, and it's just not feasible on most keyboards to reach over to the nine key every thirty seconds. When considering the hundreds of hours MMOs tend to eat up, that's an awful lot of stretching time. You can make do with custom controls, but MMO mice offer not only out-of-the-box usability, but specifically crafted ergonomics.

The Naga V3 Pro follows on pretty routinely from its predecessor with the exact same dimensions, but a lighter weight and different internals. As such, it's a pretty by-the-numbers upgrade and will fit at home in the palms of a Naga V2 Pro owner. But is it really worth $180 just to get a better sensor, cleaner clicks, and doubleshot moulded keycaps? The answer for anyone but the most hardcore (and well-off) MMO gamers is 'probably not, but it's pretty neat anyway'.
articles.author: James Bentley

articles.title: An Exclusive Castlevania Game Is Shutting Down
articles.summary: The Apple Arcade-exclusive Castlevania: Grimoire of Souls won't be playable for much longer, developer Konami has announced. In a post on social media and the game's official website, Konami confirmed Castlevania: Grimoire of Souls will be removed from Apple's gaming subscription service on August…
body: "We would like to express our gratitude to all of our players for their enthusiastic support throughout the years," Konami said. "The entire development and operations team sincerely thanks you for being part of this journey."

Konami didn't give any real reason for the decision. Originally released in 2019, Grimoire of Souls was removed from mobile storefronts and then re-released as an Apple Arcade exclusive in September 2021 with a number of improvements, including the removal of various microtransactions.

At the time of its release, Grimoire of Souls was the first new Castlevania game since 2014's Castlevania: Lord of Shadows 2. Its story concluded back in 2022 with an update that provided new revelations related to Dracula's defeat in 1990's Castlevania 3: Dracula's Curse.

Despite being on mobile, Grimoire of Souls is in many ways a traditional 2D Castlevania game, featuring character designs from longtime franchise artist Ayami Kojima and music from Michiru Yamane. Many franchise fan-favorites, including Alucard and Simon Belmont, are playable characters, and the game even supports multiplayer co-op.
articles.author: Cameron Koch

articles.title: Post Malone Actually Plays His $2 Million MTG One Ring Card
articles.summary: The Ring has a new bearer, and apparently he believes in using his collectibles. Three years after paying $2 million for the one-of-one The One Ring card, Post Malone took it out of its protective slab and put it onto the battlefield during a real game of Magic: The Gathering.
body: The musician brought the card to a recent episode of The Command Zone’s Game Knights, where he played it during a Commander match rather than simply showing off one of the rarest cards in the game’s history.
"I'm taking it out of the obnoxious big block," said Posty, as the other players gasped. "It would ruin game night."
High-value trading cards are typically kept graded and protected to preserve their condition, but Malone removed The One Ring from its case and actually used it as intended.

Malone’s card plays just like the more common versions of The One Ring: when it enters the battlefield, it grants protection from everything until the player’s next turn, then can be tapped to draw cards at the cost of accumulating burden counters that eventually drain life. What makes his copy special is the 001/001 serial number — it’s the only one in existence.
articles.author: Sam Hill

articles.title: Call Of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Beta Trailer Shows Off Franchise’s Most Ambitious Map Yet
articles.summary: Activision has released a teaser trailer for the upcoming Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 first beta weekend, and it looks pretty great. The trailer shows off some of the content in the beta, and that includes, for the first time in the franchise's history, a slice of the game's single-player…
body: The first beta runs April 21-25, and it's available for those who preorder the game on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC. The beta allows players to try the campaign mission, Entrenched, along with the modular map Kill Block (among others).

Kill Block, the most ambitious Call of Duty multiplayer map ever, mashes up several fan-favorite Call of Duty maps in a unique way that should keep players on their toes. Modern Warfare 4’s Kill Block is set at the fictional West Bridge Advanced Military Training Facility, where modular battlegrounds reconfigure before every match, creating hundreds of potential map combinations.

MW4 is coming to Nintendo Switch 2, but the first beta weekend won't be available on that platform because preorders don't begin until August 26 on Nintendo's console, for reasons Activision has not disclosed.

The MW4 beta will open to everyone August 28-31, with no preorder requirement. This second period includes the same single-player campaign mission, along with different multiplayer maps, access to the big Ground War mode, and a first opportunity to try Warzone's new Resurgence Zodiac map.
articles.author: Eddie Makuch

articles.title: Kingdom Hearts 4 Lets You Play As The Final Fantasy Universe’s Most Powerful Black Mage
articles.summary: For good reason, developers often don't let playable characters in video games get too overpowered, lest they make a game too easy to plow through. But Kingdom Hearts 4 seems to be straying from that principle, as Donald Duck was revealed to be a fully playable character in last weekend's extended…
body: In a segment of Kingdom Hearts 4 taking place in the Underworld from Hercules, players will take control of Sora's perennial sidekicks, Donald and Goofy, in platforming and battle sequences. The trailer also shows off a combo attack combining Goofy's shield-spinning and Donald's star-shooting.

"But wait," you might say. "What do you mean Donald Duck is overpowered?" Yes, Donald is the party member who fails to heal you at opportune times, but one cutscene in Kingdom Hearts 3 shows off the sheer magnitude of his wizardry at its absolute peak. A dramatic moment at the start of the story's endgame has Donald, defending his friends from Terra-Xehanort, fire off the Zettaflare spell--a feat almost unheard of in the larger Final Fantasy universe.
articles.author: Chris Compendio

articles.title: Deus Ex director and immersive sim legend Warren Spector is retiring, despite having "three games in particular" he'd still like to make
articles.summary: Warren Spector, Deus Ex director and general household name of the PC gamingverse, has announced his retirement from game development. Though, he's not completely closed the door on making a comeback down the line, alluding to three games in particular that he'd still like to make if the right…
body: "I'm retiring from game development," Spector wrote on LinkedIn, "At least I think so. I've been here before and changed my mind but this time I'm pretty sure I mean it."

With all that behind me and with age and health (my business) catching up with me I'm feeling like I've done what I set out to do. It's time to write some books, do a lot of reading, do some lecturing, maybe do some consulting.

Building on what he said earlier in the post, Spector made clear he has "mixed feelings" about stepping away. "I mean there are three games in particular I'd still like to make," he wrote. "(One is very big... one is very small... and one I don't know how to make which scares me.) But the game business has changed and it's just not as much fun for me anymore. Plus there's a new generation of developers coming up who deserve their time in the sun."
articles.author: Mark Warren

articles.title: Someone Finally Made Another Game For People Who Miss Peggle
articles.summary: We're closing in on the 20th anniversary of Peggle, and since then, nothing has come quite as close to matching the pure, joyous sensory overload of Popcap's little peg-clearing masterpiece. Can Hyperdrop fill that gap for juggling skill and luck to clear stages? Maybe!
body: Coming soon to PC, Hyperdrop is the debut game from developer Dark Dark Goose and publisher Devolver Digital is billed as a pachinko roguelite. The setup is deviously simple, as you're tasked with turning an empty pegboard into an unstoppable scoring machine. You'll be able to do just that by upgrading pegs, allowing you to activate physics-defying gravity wells, explosions, and multiball buffs whenever they're struck.

You can also upgrade your balls, making them bigger and filled with volatile energy. You can take things a step further by making them sticky or extra-bouncy, or you can use unique balls that have different properties and physics behaviors--please stop giggling. Like any good roguelite, you can expect to fail upward until you achieve that perfect run, harmoniously combining upgrades and buffs as you bounce around the stage. Once you've finished a level, you can take on increasingly difficult stages, face off in boss battles, and tinker with your builds.
articles.author: Darryn Bonthuys

articles.title: Mistfall Hunter Players Are Begging For This One Addition, And The Devs Just Won’t Do It
articles.summary: Mistfall Hunter has been out for almost three weeks now, with the extraction brawler launching on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S on July 29. Dating back to even its open beta, the community has been begging developer Bellring Games for one addition: a dedicated mode for teams of two.
body: All over the game's official subreddit are posts from players asking that the developer include a duos mode.
"I need duos," Redditor broman510 titled an August 11 post. "In this, duos vs trios seems so hard and almost impossible; most of the time [one] of us is getting jumped by 2 and poked down by one."

"We need duos," Matta114 posted on August 17. "I don't care if the game is balanced for trios. I'll take unbalanced duos over trios with some random 3rd dude that runs the opposite direction every game."

"Upvote for duos," wrote PuwudleRS in an August 8 post that generated 1.3 upvotes. "I am addicted to this game, but I CRAVE the duo experience this game has to offer. Please devs, I am begging with my life."
articles.author: Levi Winslow

articles.title: Sarah J. Maas Reveals New ‘ACOTAR’ Books, Titles and Release Dates
articles.summary: It’s been more than five years since Sarah J. Maas last published a new A Court of Thorns and Roses novel. Since 2021’s A Court of Silver Flames, her recent releases have instead focused on the Crescent City series. Now, the wait for more ACOTAR is almost over, Maas has confirmed.
body: Rejoice, romantasy fans: Maas announced Monday that the sixth book in the series will be A Court of Splintered Harmony, out Oct. 27, 2026, followed by A Court of Forgotten Melody on Jan. 12, 2027.

The books will begin The Valkyrie Cycle, a new storyline continuing the ACOTAR series. Maas revealed the titles and covers in back-to-back Instagram posts, while digital billboards announcing the books appeared in Los Angeles, Denver, and New York City.

Maas first explained the books’ unusual structure during a March appearance on the Call Her Daddy podcast, describing them as one enormous, continuous story rather than a traditional trilogy. A Court of Splintered Harmony contains the story’s first movement, while A Court of Forgotten Melody contains movements two and three. A third, still-untitled book will contain the final movement.
Maas teased A Court of Splintered Harmony with the line, “What was broken will be remade,” while A Court of Forgotten Melody promises, “What was lost will be reclaimed.”
articles.author: Sam Hill

videos.title: DF Direct Weekly #277: Crimson Desert Switch 2 Confirmed, Gears E-Day PC Tested, Viture XR Glasses!
videos.summary: Thanks to Alienware for sponsoring DF Direct. To learn more about the Alienware AREA-51 Gaming Desktop, check out:
body: The team reacts to Pearl Abyss' statement that Crimson Desert is - somehow - coming to Switch 2, but the first order of business is to share impressions (and performance testing) for the Gears of War E-Day MP beta on PC... and while extremely impressive, we do have some concerns. Rich tests a remarkable system for playing Switch 2 games on the go in TV move with a virtual 174-inch OLED display, John's excited by a new wave of announced VR titles, there's curiousity around Xbox/Game Pass app games coming to Linux and there's some eyebrow-raising data on Resident Evil Requiem physical disc sales.
